description: This PHP test class defines unit tests for the CandidateOfferDecliningAPI component within the Recruitment API of the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup routines, mock injections, and test cases for 'getOne', 'getValidationRuleForGetOne', 'update', 'delete', and 'getValidationRuleForDelete' methods, with some tests expectingNotImplementedExceptions and others performing validation checks.

classes.name: CandidateOfferDecliningAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the CandidateOfferDecliningAPI endpoints related to declining candidate offers in the OrangeHRM Recruitment module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by truncating CandidateHistory table before each test.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of the API, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rule method for 'getOne', expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive test of the 'update' API method using provided test case data, including fixture setup and mock service registration.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides data for the 'testUpdate' method, loading test cases from a YAML configuration.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the 'delete' method of the API, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests the validation rule method for 'delete', expecting a not implemented exception.
